chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Pay for Porgy and Bess and Nazarro's handling
summary: They earned about $750 or $800 a week for two, less than the Follies, and he blames himself rather than race or Nazarro.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: You had said before that there was a similar situation with the handling of you getting this job as the handling of what Nazarro did of you getting the job in the Ziegfeld Follies. Can you tell me about that?
Say that again?
There was a similar handling by Nazarro of you getting the job in the Ziegfeld Follies as there was -- in 'Porgy and Bess' as there was in the Ziegfeld Follies.
Yeah, because I just told ya, when I told you about the salary
couldn't afford to pay the salary, the manager couldn't pay, that was it, did you get that?
Yeh.
Well, that was it.
But it happened again, the same type of thing.

That was it. That's what I'm trying to say to you now. The other one was when Nazarro was trying to get another act in our stead on another job. This way, this guy was trying to undersell Buck and Bubbles for less money than what they should get.
Well, did Buck and Bubbles actually get paid well for 'Porgy and Bess?'
As much as I could get.
How much was that?
Oh, I'd say $800 a week.
So you were getting the same thing in this show as you had gotten in the Ziegfeld Follies.

I got less in this show. I got less because of the difference of payment when you're getting $800 in the show to go for two people and getting $800 to go with (inaudible). To me it is, how do you figure it?
I'm not sure I know what you mean.
You said I was getting the same.
As you did in the Ziegfeld Follies, you got the same as you did in "Porgy and Bess." It was the same pay. You both got $800 for both shows.
Yeah. I think there was a difference there, I think the Ziegfeld Follies was $800 and "Porgy and Bess" was $750, I think it was.
So you weren't really achieving the money --
That's what I'm saying, that's what I'm talking about all the time, that's what I'm telling ya all the time.
Was that because -- primarily it was Nat Nazarro, he was underselling you.
I don't know what the cause was, whether he didn't ask for the money, I don't know what it was, really.
That was because you were --
I just figured it was me, that's all.
Do you think it had something to do with your being black instead of a white act?
I just figured -- white act, I don't think about that -- I just figured it was me. Nobody's fault but mine, okay? I could have charged you $10,000, if you want to pay me all right, if you don't want
to pay me, forget it. But I didn't say that. I'd take that to make ends meet, so that's what happened.
